fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/op asserts every field used in this repo's log is known for its kind (intent statement, milestone, umbrella; capability statement, acceptance, built_in; evidence statement, result, tests, test, status, head, pr, command, observed; and the decision, source, question, constraint and actor fields) and that bogus on an evidence node is unknown
fields.statement: Each core node kind has a fixed list of known fields in internal/op, covering every field in use today

fields.acceptance: A new field-schema.txtar has add evidence --field bogus=x exit 2 naming the known fields, and a hand-written log entry with an unknown field still passes fold-ok and check; scripts that used made-up field names are changed to real ones; make check passes
fields.statement: rhiza add and rhiza set refuse a field the node's kind does not have, as a usage error naming the known fields, while nodes already in the log with unknown fields still read and fold
